title: 第17章 蜜蜂杀手大妖第18章 可怜的大妖师父和师姐
content_zh:
“呸。”
入夜的白云派，热闹不断。
危险隐藏其中，一双眼眸，微微闪烁，很快隐藏于黑暗之中。
它的身影，埋藏于某一棵树之中，十分隐秘。
“该死的白云派，等到本妖离开之后，一定会报复的。”
“本妖被你们折磨如此之久，差一点被干掉了，这笔账，本妖不会罢休的。”
“白云派的老不死，本妖和你们不共戴天。”
细小的身影，掠过了白云派。
继续隐藏着。
几个身影穿过了树林，却没能发现它的身影。
连续几波身影穿过，都没人停下来。
似乎，这棵树并没有什么神奇的地方。
到了下半夜，那一道身影闪烁着翅膀，离开了那棵树，朝着下一个地方隐秘。
不定时转换位置，同一个位置不能待太久，谨慎小心的它，逐渐远离了搜索的人群。
“是灵药的味道。”
“好浓郁，就在前面那座山。”
“吞噬了那些灵药，本妖的修为很快得到恢复。”
“天助我也。”
小小的身躯，摇摇晃晃前进。
入夜的灵药峰。

被星光笼罩，俨然化作了明亮之地。
星月草发出了微弱的光芒，渲染了整座灵药峰，无数星光闪烁，融入了阵法，加强阵法。
修炼当中的许君白睁开了眼睛，露出了一抹微笑。
“来客人了。”
深夜前来，可不是客人。
许君白走出了房间，飞魂蝶和大公猪也都感应到了，它们等候许君白多时。
飞魂蝶晃动身影，缓缓隐匿于黑暗。
许君白点点头，大公猪也跟着隐藏。
一人，两宠物，全部隐藏起来。
山间，迎来了一道身影。
身影十分隐秘，警惕性拉满。
“人呢？”
“背叛者就在山上，可为何，没有了他的气息？”
“是大人的消息错误，还是？”
蜜蜂缓缓前进，躲避星月草发出的光芒，他的到来，不能被发现。
刺杀，乃是他的专业工作。
躲藏到了深夜，才选择动手。
此刻乃是修炼入神的时候，也是最好动手的时机。
一步步往上走，小心翼翼的他，查看每一步的位置，生怕碰到了陷阱或者是阵法。
终于，耗费了不少时间，他来到了山顶，看到了那一座房子。

“终于来到了。”
content_en:
"Bah."
At night, the Baiyun Sect is bustling with activity.
The danger was hidden inside, a pair of eyes flickered slightly, and were quickly hidden in the darkness.
Its figure is buried in a certain tree, very secretive.
"The damn Baiyun Sect will definitely take revenge after this demon leaves."
"I have been tortured by you for so long and was almost killed. I will not let go of this debt."
"Old Immortal of the Baiyun Sect, this demon is at odds with you."
The small figure passed by the Baiyun Sect.
Continue to hide.
Several figures passed through the woods, but they could not find it.
Several waves of figures passed through, but no one stopped.
It seems that there is nothing magical about this tree.
In the second half of the night, the figure flickered its wings, left the tree, and hid in the next place.
It changed positions from time to time and could not stay in the same position for too long. It was cautious and gradually moved away from the searching crowd.
"It smells like elixir."
"It's so rich, right on the mountain in front."
"After swallowing those elixirs, this demon's cultivation level was quickly restored."
"God help me."
The small body swayed forward.
The elixir peak at night.
Shrouded in starlight, it seemed to have turned into a bright place.
The Star-Moon Grass gave off a faint light, rendering the entire elixir peak. Countless starlights flickered, integrating into the formation and strengthening it.
Xu Junbai, who was practicing, opened his eyes and smiled.
"We have guests."
You are not a guest if you come late at night.
Xu Junbai walked out of the room, and Feihun Butterfly and Big Boar also sensed it. They waited for Xu Junbai for a long time.
The flying soul butterfly swayed and slowly disappeared into the darkness.
Xu Junbai nodded, and the big boar also hid.
One person, two pets, all hidden.
In the mountains, a figure came.
His figure is very secretive and he is full of vigilance.
"Where are the people?"
"The traitor is on the mountain, but why is there no trace of him?"
"Is the message wrong, sir?"
The bee moved forward slowly, avoiding the light emitted by the Star-Moon Grass. His arrival could not be detected.
Assassination is his professional job.
He hid until late at night before choosing to take action.
This is the time to practice to become a god, and it is also the best time to take action.
He walked up step by step, carefully checking the position of each step for fear of running into a trap or formation.
Finally, after spending a lot of time, he reached the top of the mountain and saw the house.
"It's finally here."
